text: dsh-skills-manager 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的技能管理插件：它在每轮 agent 步骤中匹配可用技能，并按自动加载或建议模式注入内容。它还把声明式技能 Hook 接入会话与工具事件，提供 Git 来源安装、更新、卸载及按用户或项目设置覆盖的能力。用户可通过 skill_manager 工具或 Settings 页面管理模式、触发词和配置；使用需兼容版本的 DSH、Node.js 与 Git，调用安装命令时从配置的 Git 来源同步。

dsh-skills-manager matches skills to DSH prompts and injects instructions or suggestions. It connects skill hooks to session and tool events, and manages Git sources plus user or project overrides through the skill_manager tool and Web Settings. Requires compatible DSH, Node.js, and Git for sync.
想让 DSH 根据我当前的问题自动加载相关 Skill。
有没有办法在匹配度不够时只提醒我查看某个技能？
我想给不同 Skill 配触发词和自动或建议加载模式。
怎样让 DSH 的工具调用前后触发技能定义的规则？
需要从 Git 仓库安装并同步一组 DSH Skills。
我希望在网页设置里管理技能，并分别配置项目和用户级覆盖。
How can I automatically load relevant skill instructions for each DSH prompt?
I want to manage Git-hosted skills and their activation triggers from a web settings page.
dsh-skills-manager 的功能「技能匹配与注入」：每轮 agent 步骤会为可用技能评分，并按配置自动注入完整内容或发送轻量建议。
dsh-skills-manager 的功能「技能生命周期 Hook」：将技能声明的会话启动、提示提交及工具前后 Hook 接入 DSH 事件，匹配时注入上下文或应用工具决策。
dsh-skills-manager 的功能「技能管理界面」：Web Settings 页面列出技能与来源，并提供模式、触发词、Hook、安装更新及移除等管理操作。
dsh-skills-manager 的功能「模型管理工具」：模型可调用 skill_manager 查看状态、安装或更新 Git 来源、卸载技能，并修改激活模式、触发词、Hook 与配置。
dsh-skills-manager 使用前须知：安装或更新 Git 来源需要本机可调用 Git，并会从用户配置的仓库地址同步来源内容。
dsh-skills-manager 使用前须知：插件面向 DSH Web 客户端，并要求兼容版本的 DSH 与 Node.js；安装后需重启 Web Profile。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Why this plugin：The built-in DSH `skill` tool relies on the model to notice a short summary and decide to load the full skill. In practice, useful skills are often missed, skill files cannot directly declare lifecycle behavior, and locally scattered skills are difficult to keep synchronized.

`dsh-skills-manager` closes those gaps:

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Highlights：| Icon | Capability | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🚀 | Proactive activation | Full skill injection for strong matches and lightweight reminders for suggestions |
| 🪝 | Skill-level hooks | `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, and `SessionStart` |
| 🔄 | GitHub lifecycle | Install, update, authoritative sync, uninstall, and commit-change reporting |
| 🧭 | Workspace-aware scope | Project skills override user skills without leaking configuration between workspaces |
| 🛠️ | Built-in management | Settings UI plus the `skill_manager` model tool |
| 🛂 | Install consent gate | A model-initiated `install` or `update` asks once. It fails closed without an approval channel. |
| 🧩 | Capability proposal | An opt-in catalog proposes missing skills. One card per turn. It never auto-installs. |
| 🛡️ | Guardrails | Source allowlisting, argument-array Git execution, hook path validation, and no shell execution for hooks |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · How it works：By default, a turn can auto-load up to two skills and suggest up to three. Activation markers are stored in conversation history, so full skill content is not injected repeatedly while it remains visible. After context compaction removes a marker, the skill can be loaded again automatically.

Two separate constraints keep the model from acting on its own:

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · How it works：- **Install consent gate.** Before a model-initiated `skill_manager install` or `skill_manager update` runs any Git command, the plugin asks the host approval seam for one decision. Only `allowed-once` proceeds. Rejection, cancellation, a missing channel, or a thrown request all deny. The model receives a degradation note and a structured code (see [Install consent gate](#install-consent-gate)).
- **Capability proposal.** When an opt-in candidate catalog names sources that are not installed, the matcher may inject a proposal into the turn's first step. The proposal is model context, not a UI card, and it never installs anything on its own — the model must still call `install`, which the gate above will intercept. The branch is off by default and stays silent when the catalog is missing, the score is low, or every declared skill is already installed (see [Candidate catalog](#candidate-catalog)).

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Install from npm (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @existence001100/dsh-skills-manager
```

DSH recognizes the package's `dsh.bundle` manifest and adds `@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager` to the Web profile automatically. Restart a running Web profile after installation.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Install from GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Existence001100/dsh-skills-manager
```

Use the GitHub source when testing unreleased changes from `main`. Pin a commit when reproducibility matters.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Update or remove：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update @existence001100/dsh-skills-manager
dsh plugin --profile web remove @existence001100/dsh-skills-manager
```

Restart the profile after either operation so its composition matches the installed bundle set.

git clone https://github.com/Existence001100/dsh-skills-manager.git
cd dsh-skills-manager
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
dsh plugin --profile web add .

The included `cordis.patch.yml` inserts `skill-manager` into the host composition for all sessions.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Compatibility：The `0.1.3-alpha.1` adaptation supports `session.snapshotEvents()` and array-based surface nodes while retaining the legacy events API. Full install/UI smoke testing for that release is pending availability of its host packages on npm.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Compatibility：For DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, use plugin `1.0.6` or later: older plugin versions emit `source.kind: "plugin"`, which DSH's v4 session format rejects. A live Web-profile test invoked `/ponytail-help`, loaded its full instructions (`skill-invocation`), recorded the manager notice as `plugin:dsh-skills-manager`, and completed the turn. This verifies explicit skill invocation and manager injection; other `0.2.x` host versions are outside the current peer range.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Compatibility：DSH is in developer preview. Pin the plugin to a commit when reproducibility matters, and re-run the install smoke test when upgrading DSH dependencies.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Skill configuration：Declare activation and hooks directly in SKILL.md frontmatter:

```yaml
---
name: repo-hardening
description: Review and harden a repository with build/test gates.
metadata:

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Activation modes：| Mode | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `auto` | A match injects the complete skill immediately |
| `suggest` | A match adds a lightweight reminder so the model can load the skill |
| `off` | The skill never participates automatically but remains manually invocable |

Codex-style `manual` and `disabled` values are accepted as aliases for `off`. If `activation` is omitted, skills with explicit triggers default to `auto`; all others default to `suggest`.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Activation modes：DSH also accepts `/name` for a user-invocable skill. This loads the full instructions directly, regardless of whether the manager would suggest it; `suggest` alone only adds a reminder.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Triggers and policies：- Plain trigger strings use case-insensitive substring matching.
- Values prefixed with `re:` are treated as regular expressions; invalid expressions are ignored.
- `PreToolUse.tool` accepts a concrete tool name or `*`.
- Tool policies return `allow`, `deny`, or `ask` with an optional reason.
- User overrides can be stored outside upstream SKILL.md files so updates do not erase local policy.

Example overrides:

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Hook compatibility：| Skill hook | DSH host event | Support |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `UserPromptSubmit` | `agent/pre-step` | ✅ Inject text on every submission while active |
| `PreToolUse` | `tools/pre-execute` | ✅ Allow, deny, or ask based on tool and arguments |
| `PostToolUse` | `tools/post-execute` | ✅ Activate a skill from matching tool output |
| `PostToolUseFailure` | `tools/post-execute` | ✅ Match failure text through the same result event |
| `SessionStart` | `agent/session-start` | ✅ Activate before matching is required |
| `SessionEnd` / `Stop` | `agent/disposed` / `agent/turn-stopping` | ⚠️ Observable only; no content injection |
| `PreCompact` | No DSH core equivalent | ⚠️ Not implemented; removed activation markers allow reinjection |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · GitHub-managed skills：State is stored in `<DSH_HOME>/skill-manager.json`, including sources, refs, commits, installed paths, scoped overrides, and the 50 most recent operations.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Install consent gate：The model cannot install or update a Git source on its own. Each model-initiated `skill_manager install` and `skill_manager update` call asks for one decision first.

| `installGate` | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `ask` (default) | Shows one approval card, then runs only after the user allows that call. |
| `deny` | Blocks the call without a card. The model learns the reason and can point the user to Settings. |
| `off` | Restores the 1.0.x behavior. Nothing asks. |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Install consent gate：The card names the source and says the install copies the whole repository. The card also states that hooks stay unverified before installation. The plugin has not cloned the repository yet.

The gate fails closed. If no approval channel is available, if the request throws, or if the user rejects or cancels, then no Git command runs. The model receives a short degradation note and a structured code:

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Install consent gate：| `code` | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `user-rejected` | The user rejected the card. |
| `approval-cancelled` | The user cancelled the card, or the turn aborted. |
| `approval-unavailable` | No approval answerer is mounted in this deployment. |
| `approval-error` | The approval request threw. |
| `policy-deny` | `installGate` is `deny`. |
| `invalid-source` | The URL is missing or unsupported. The text repeats the install error word for word. |
| `no-agent` | The call has no agent, so no user can be asked. |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Candidate catalog：| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `repo` | Required. A Git source that passes the same allowlist as `install`. |
| `description` | Required. The matching text. Capped at 300 characters. |
| `triggers` | Optional. Same syntax as `metadata.triggers`. Capped at 32 entries. |
| `skills` | Optional. Declared skill names. Unverified until installed. |
| `hooks` | Optional. Declared event names. Unverified until installed. |
| `verified` | Optional. The curator checked the repository by hand. |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Candidate catalog：- The path comes from `candidateCatalogPath`. The default is `<DSH_HOME>/skill-manager-candidates.json`.
- Caps: 200 entries, 300-character descriptions, 32 triggers per entry.
- A `repo` outside the Git allowlist is dropped. The catalog never widens what may be cloned.
- The catalog lists sources. It is not a registry: installed-skill metadata still comes only from `ctx.skills`.
- Turn it on with `skill_manager set-config config={"proposeEnabled":true}`.
- Tune it with `proposeThreshold` (default 7) and `maxPropose` (default 1, at most one card per turn).
- The branch stays silent when the file is missing, the score is low, or every declared skill is installed.
- A failed load logs one warning per file version. The same broken file does not repeat the warning.
- A proposal is model context. It may not appear in the conversation, and no UI tracks it.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Project-scoped skills：The filesystem provider resolves skill roots in priority order:

| Priority | Root | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `<project>/.dsh/skills` | `project-dsh` |
| 2 | `<project>/.agents/skills` | `project-agents` |
| 3 | Host-configured directory | `custom` |
| 4 | `<DSH_HOME>/skills` | `user-dsh` |
| 5 | `<agentsHome>/skills` | `user-agents` |
| 6 | Bundled skills | `bundled` |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Project-scoped skills：Project skills participate in the same matching pipeline and win same-name conflicts by priority. Mode, trigger, and hook overrides are keyed by `scope` plus `cwd`, preventing settings from leaking across projects or into user-level skills.

Project-local skills remain owned by the project's Git repository. The manager's `update` operation synchronizes user-level sources only; filesystem watchers refresh project changes.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Model tool：The `skill_manager` tool supports `status`, `install`, `update`, `uninstall`, `set-mode`, `set-triggers`, `set-hooks`, and `set-config`. Project records use `scope: project` plus a required `cwd`.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Permissions and data：| Surface | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Filesystem reads | Reads DSH user and project skill roots selected by the host, plus metadata from configured Git sources |
| Filesystem writes | Stores sources under `<DSH_HOME>/skill-sources`, manager-owned skills under `<DSH_HOME>/skills`, and state in `<DSH_HOME>/skill-manager.json` |
| Network | Invokes the local `git` executable only for user-requested source installation or update; the plugin implements no telemetry |
| Processes | Runs `git` with argument arrays and may run explicitly declared in-repository Node lifecycle hooks with time and output limits |
| Agent-initiated install | Asks for one approval decision before any Git command runs, and fails closed without an approval channel |
| Credentials | Does not store Git credentials; authentication remains owned by the user's Git configuration and credential helper |
| Conversation context | Reads the active prompt and skill catalog for matching, then injects activation or suggestion messages into the current session |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Permissions and data：Uninstalling a manager-owned skill removes its copied skill directory. Locally authored skills that have no managed Git source are not removed by the manager.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Security：- Git sources must match the supported URL allowlist.
- Git arguments are passed as arrays, not interpolated shell commands.
- Skill hooks do not run through a shell.
- Manifest hook paths must resolve to Node scripts inside the cloned repository.
- Malformed regular expressions and unsupported hook declarations are ignored.

Installing a plugin with executable hooks means trusting that repository's code. Review third-party sources before installation.
@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Security：See [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) for supported versions and private vulnerability reporting.

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Decisions we deliberately do not make：| Decision | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Install without asking | The user keeps the final decision. This plugin never installs on its own, so a silent-install mode stays out of scope. |
| An approve, modify, reject card | The DSH approval card supports allow-once and reject only. A modify step has no seam. |
| Probe a repository for hooks before install | The probe needs a clone and network time. The card states the limit instead of guessing. |
| A timeout that rejects an unanswered card | Any timeout value is arbitrary. An unanswered card already fails closed, because nothing runs until the user answers. |
| Store skill metadata in a candidate catalog | The catalog is a listing of installable sources. `ctx.skills` stays the only source of installed-skill metadata. |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 为什么需要这个插件：DSH 内置的 `skill` 工具依赖模型先注意到一段简短摘要，再自行决定是否加载完整 Skill。实际使用中，模型经常错过有价值的 Skill；Skill 文件无法直接声明生命周期行为；散落在本地的 Skill 也很难持续同步。

`dsh-skills-manager` 补齐了这些能力：

- 每轮请求都主动匹配可用 Skill；
- 强匹配自动加载，弱匹配轻量提醒；
- 将 Claude Code 风格的 Hook 声明映射到 DSH 宿主事件；
- 从 GitHub 安装、更新和卸载 Skill；
- 隔离用户级与项目级覆盖配置；
- 同时提供 Settings 界面和 `skill_manager` 模型工具。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 核心特性：| 图标 | 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🚀 | 主动激活 | 强匹配注入完整 Skill，建议匹配只注入轻量提醒 |
| 🪝 | Skill 级 Hook | 支持 `UserPromptSubmit`、`PreToolUse`、`PostToolUse`、`PostToolUseFailure` 和 `SessionStart` |
| 🔄 | GitHub 生命周期 | 安装、更新、权威同步、卸载和 commit 变更报告 |
| 🧭 | Workspace 作用域 | 项目 Skill 可覆盖用户 Skill，同时避免配置跨 workspace 泄漏 |
| 🛠️ | 内置管理 | Settings 管理界面与 `skill_manager` 模型工具 |
| 🛂 | 安装确认门控 | 模型发起的 `install` / `update` 先请求一次审批；无审批通道时 fail-closed |
| 🧩 | 能力缺口提案 | 可选候选目录提出缺失技能建议；每轮最多一条，绝不自动安装 |
| 🛡️ | 安全护栏 | 来源白名单、Git 参数数组、Hook 路径校验，Hook 不经过 shell |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 工作原理：```mermaid
flowchart LR
    U[用户消息] --> M[步骤前匹配器]
    M -->|auto| A[注入完整 Skill]
    M -->|suggest| S[注入轻量提醒]

每个 Agent 步骤开始前，插件都会为可用 Skill 打分：

1. 明确提及 Skill 名称：**+12**；
2. 命中触发词或正则表达式：**+7**；
3. 描述或 `whenToUse` 词元重合：**+4 到 +6**。

默认每轮最多自动加载 2 个 Skill、建议 3 个。激活标记会写入会话历史；只要标记仍在可见上下文中，就不会重复注入完整内容。上下文压缩移除标记后，Skill 可以再次自动加载。

两条独立约束保证模型不会自作主张：

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 工作原理：- **安装确认门控。** 模型发起的 `skill_manager install` 与 `skill_manager update` 在执行任何 Git 命令之前，都会先向宿主审批接缝请求一次决定。只有 `allowed-once` 才继续；拒绝、取消、通道缺失或请求抛错一律 deny。模型会收到降级说明和结构化 code（见[安装确认门控](#安装确认门控)）。
- **能力缺口提案。** 当可选的候选目录列出了尚未安装的来源时，匹配器可以在该轮首个 step 注入一条提案。提案属于模型上下文，不是 UI 卡片，也绝不会自动安装——模型仍需调用 `install`，而该调用会被上面的门控拦截。该分支默认关闭；目录缺失、分数不足、或声明的技能都已安装时保持静默（见[候选目录](#候选目录)）。

dsh plugin --profile web add @existence001100/dsh-skills-manager
```

DSH 会识别包内的 `dsh.bundle` manifest，并自动把 `@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager` 加入 Web Profile。安装完成后，请重启正在运行的 Web Profile。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 从 GitHub 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Existence001100/dsh-skills-manager
```

需要测试 `main` 中尚未发布的变更时，可以使用 GitHub 来源；如需可复现安装，请固定到具体 commit。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 更新或卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update @existence001100/dsh-skills-manager
dsh plugin --profile web remove @existence001100/dsh-skills-manager
```

执行任一操作后请重启 Profile，确保运行时 composition 与已安装 Bundle 一致。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 安装本地 Checkout 进行开发：```sh
git clone https://github.com/Existence001100/dsh-skills-manager.git
cd dsh-skills-manager
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
dsh plugin --profile web add .

插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会把 `skill-manager` 插入宿主 composition，对所有会话生效。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 兼容性：使用 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 时，请安装本插件 `1.0.6` 或更新版本：旧版插件发出的 `source.kind: "plugin"` 会被 DSH v4 会话格式拒绝。真实 Web Profile 测试中，`/ponytail-help` 成功注入完整 Skill 内容（`skill-invocation`），管理器消息使用 `plugin:dsh-skills-manager`，整轮对话正常完成。这验证了显式 Skill 调用和管理器注入；其他 `0.2.x` 宿主版本不在当前 peer 依赖范围内。

DSH 仍处于 developer preview。需要可复现安装时，请把插件固定到具体 commit；升级 DSH 依赖后应重新运行安装烟测。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Skill 配置：在 SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 中直接声明激活条件与 Hook：

```yaml
---
name: repo-hardening
description: Review and harden a repository with build/test gates.
metadata:

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 激活模式：| 模式 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `auto` | 命中后立即注入完整 Skill |
| `suggest` | 命中后添加轻量提醒，由模型决定是否加载 |
| `off` | 不参与自动匹配，但模型仍可手动调用 |

Codex 风格的 `manual` 与 `disabled` 会作为 `off` 的别名处理。如果没有声明 `activation`，带显式 triggers 的 Skill 默认为 `auto`，其他 Skill 默认为 `suggest`。

对于允许用户调用的 Skill，DSH 还支持输入 `/name` 直接加载完整内容，不受管理器是否建议该 Skill 的影响；单独的 `suggest` 只会添加提醒。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 触发词与策略：- 普通触发词执行大小写不敏感的子串匹配。
- `re:` 前缀表示正则表达式；无效正则会被忽略。
- `PreToolUse.tool` 可以填写具体工具名或 `*`。
- 工具策略返回 `allow`、`deny` 或 `ask`，并可附带原因。
- 用户覆盖配置可以存储在上游 SKILL.md 之外，避免更新时丢失本地策略。

覆盖配置示例：

```text
skill_manager set-triggers ponytail-review triggers=["review this diff","过度设计"]
skill_manager set-hooks repo-hardening hooks={"PostToolUse":[{"tool":"bash","when":"re:exit code [1-9]","action":"activate"}]}
```

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Hook 兼容性：| Skill Hook | DSH 宿主事件 | 支持情况 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `UserPromptSubmit` | `agent/pre-step` | ✅ 激活期间每轮注入声明文本 |
| `PreToolUse` | `tools/pre-execute` | ✅ 根据工具名与参数执行 allow、deny 或 ask |
| `PostToolUse` | `tools/post-execute` | ✅ 工具输出命中后激活 Skill |
| `PostToolUseFailure` | `tools/post-execute` | ✅ 通过同一结果事件匹配失败文本 |
| `SessionStart` | `agent/session-start` | ✅ 无需匹配即可在会话开始时激活 |
| `SessionEnd` / `Stop` | `agent/disposed` / `agent/turn-stopping` | ⚠️ 仅可观察，不注入内容 |
| `PreCompact` | DSH 核心无对应事件 | ⚠️ 未实现；压缩移除激活标记后可重新注入 |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · GitHub 托管的 Skills：管理器接受 `owner/repo` 简写，以及完整的 `https://`、`git@` 或 `ssh://` Git URL。

```text
skill_manager install owner/repo
skill_manager update
skill_manager status
skill_manager uninstall skill-name

安装过程中，插件会：

1. 将单一分支浅克隆到 `<DSH_HOME>/skill-sources/<slug>`；
2. 在最多 3 层目录中发现包含 SKILL.md 的目录；
3. 跳过 `.git`、`node_modules`、`dist` 和 `build`；
4. 把发现的 Skill 复制到 `<DSH_HOME>/skills/<name>`。

更新时会拉取配置的 ref，把来源重置到 `FETCH_HEAD`，再对已安装 Skill 执行权威同步。随后文件监视器自动使目录缓存失效并派发 `skills/change`。

插件 Manifest 按以下顺序检测：

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · GitHub 托管的 Skills：1. `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`；
2. `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`。

Settings 页面会展示插件名称、版本、Skills 和 Hook 数量。Manifest 中指向仓库内部 Node 脚本的安全生命周期 Hook，可用于 `SessionStart` 与 `UserPromptSubmit`。

状态保存在 `<DSH_HOME>/skill-manager.json`，包括来源、ref、commit、安装路径、作用域覆盖和最近 50 条操作记录。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 安装确认门控：模型不能自行安装或更新 Git 来源。每一次模型发起的 `skill_manager install` 与 `skill_manager update` 调用，都会先请求一次决定。

| `installGate` | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `ask`（默认） | 弹出一张审批卡，用户允许这一次后才执行。 |
| `deny` | 不弹卡，直接拒绝。模型会收到原因，并可指引用户去 Settings。 |
| `off` | 恢复 1.0.x 行为，不再询问。 |

卡片会写出 Git 来源，并说明安装会复制整个仓库。卡片同时说明：安装前 Hook 仍处于未验证状态，因为此时还没有克隆仓库。

门控是 fail-closed。审批通道不可用、请求抛错、用户拒绝或取消时，不会执行任何 Git 命令。模型会收到一段降级说明和一个结构化 code：

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 安装确认门控：| `code` | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| `user-rejected` | 用户拒绝了这张卡。 |
| `approval-cancelled` | 用户取消，或所在 turn 被中止。 |
| `approval-unavailable` | 当前部署没有挂载审批应答器。 |
| `approval-error` | 审批请求抛错。 |
| `policy-deny` | `installGate` 为 `deny`。 |
| `invalid-source` | URL 缺失或不受支持。文案与安装报错逐字一致。 |
| `no-agent` | 这次调用没有 agent，无法询问用户。 |

通过模型工具配置门控：

```text
skill_manager set-config config={"installGate":"off"}
```

门控是插件策略，不是 Skill Hook。Skill 无法关闭它。

用户在 Settings → **Skill 管理** 中自己发起的安装不会被询问。用户发起动作，本身已经作出决定。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 候选目录：只有当候选目录列出可安装来源时，插件才能提出能力缺口。该目录默认关闭，需要手动开启。

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "entries": [
    {

| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `repo` | 必填。必须通过与 `install` 相同的来源白名单。 |
| `description` | 必填。用于匹配的文本，上限 300 字符。 |
| `triggers` | 可选。语法同 `metadata.triggers`，上限 32 条。 |
| `skills` | 可选。声明的技能名，安装前未验证。 |
| `hooks` | 可选。声明的事件名，安装前未验证。 |
| `verified` | 可选。维护者已人工核对仓库。 |

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 候选目录：- 路径来自 `candidateCatalogPath`，默认 `<DSH_HOME>/skill-manager-candidates.json`。
- 上限：200 条条目、描述 300 字符、每条 32 个触发词。
- 不在 Git 白名单内的 `repo` 整条丢弃。候选目录不能扩大可克隆范围。
- 候选目录只列来源，不是注册表：已安装技能元数据仍只来自 `ctx.skills`。
- 用 `skill_manager set-config config={"proposeEnabled":true}` 开启。
- 用 `proposeThreshold`（默认 7）与 `maxPropose`（默认 1，每轮最多一张）调节。
- 文件缺失、分数不足、或声明的技能都已安装时，分支保持静默。
- 加载失败时每个文件版本只警告一次，同一个坏文件不会重复刷日志。
- 提案属于模型上下文，可能不会出现在对话里，也没有 UI 追踪。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 项目级 Skills：Filesystem Provider 按以下优先级解析 Skill 根目录：

| 优先级 | 根目录 | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `<project>/.dsh/skills` | `project-dsh` |
| 2 | `<project>/.agents/skills` | `project-agents` |
| 3 | 宿主配置的目录 | `custom` |
| 4 | `<DSH_HOME>/skills` | `user-dsh` |
| 5 | `<agentsHome>/skills` | `user-agents` |
| 6 | 内置 Skills | `bundled` |

项目 Skill 使用同一套匹配流程，并凭优先级在同名冲突中胜出。模式、触发词与 Hook 覆盖按 `scope` 和 `cwd` 存储，避免设置跨项目或泄漏到用户级 Skill。

项目内 Skill 仍由项目自己的 Git 仓库管理。管理器的 `update` 只同步用户级来源；项目改动由文件监视器自动刷新。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · Settings 界面：*页面展示激活控制、来源信息和 Skill 管理操作。*

Settings → **Skill 管理** 提供：

- 跟随 DSH 当前显示语言切换的英文与简体中文界面；
- 主动激活总开关；
- 每轮自动加载数量限制；
- GitHub 安装与更新操作；
- 每个 Skill 的模式、触发词、Hook、来源与 commit 信息；
- 项目 workspace 选择；
- 卸载操作与最近历史。
@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 模型工具：`skill_manager` 支持 `status`、`install`、`update`、`uninstall`、`set-mode`、`set-triggers`、`set-hooks` 与 `set-config`。项目记录使用 `scope: project`，并且必须提供 `cwd`。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 权限与数据：| 范围 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 文件读取 | 读取宿主选择的 DSH 用户级与项目级 Skill 根目录，以及已配置 Git 来源中的元数据 |
| 文件写入 | 来源保存在 `<DSH_HOME>/skill-sources`，管理器拥有的 Skill 保存在 `<DSH_HOME>/skills`，状态保存在 `<DSH_HOME>/skill-manager.json` |
| 网络 | 仅在用户请求安装或更新来源时调用本地 `git`；插件不实现遥测 |
| 进程 | 以参数数组运行 `git`，并可执行仓库内显式声明的 Node 生命周期 Hook，附带时间与输出限制 |
| 模型发起的安装 | 执行任何 Git 命令前先请求一次审批决定；没有审批通道时 fail-closed |
| 凭据 | 不保存 Git 凭据；身份验证仍由用户的 Git 配置和凭据助手负责 |
| 会话上下文 | 读取当前提示与 Skill 目录进行匹配，并向当前会话注入激活或建议消息 |
@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 权限与数据：卸载管理器拥有的 Skill 时会删除其复制目录。没有托管 Git 来源的本地手写 Skill 不会被管理器删除。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 安全：- Git 来源必须匹配受支持的 URL 白名单。
- Git 参数以数组传递，不拼接为 shell 命令。
- Skill Hook 不经过 shell 执行。
- Manifest Hook 路径必须解析到克隆仓库内部的 Node 脚本。
- 无效正则和不受支持的 Hook 声明会被忽略。

安装带有可执行 Hook 的插件，意味着信任该仓库的代码。安装第三方来源前请先进行审查。

受支持版本与私密漏洞报告方式见 [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)。

@existence001100/dsh-skills-manager README · 明确不做的决策：| 决策 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 不经询问直接安装 | 最终决定权留给用户。插件从不自行安装，因此也不提供静默安装模式。 |
| approve / modify / reject 三态卡片 | DSH 审批卡只支持 allow-once 与 reject。modify 没有可落地的接缝。 |
| 安装前探测仓库的 Hook | 探测需要克隆和网络时间。卡片如实说明限制，不做猜测。 |
| 对未应答卡片做超时自动拒绝 | 任何超时数值都是武断的。未应答本身已经是 fail-closed，因为用户回答前不会执行任何操作。 |
| 把技能元数据存进候选目录 | 候选目录只列可安装来源。已安装技能元数据仍只来自 `ctx.skills`。 |
